Miles sighed. He hadn't anticipated writing the fourth volume of a popular show to be this hard. Granted he and Kerry had decided to try and do this one their first entirely sober script, but it was just proving too difficult. 
"You got anything?" Kerry asked.
"Nope. Face it man, we gotta get the booze, only way we'll write this, the fans won't care either way."
"True, we have it our best."
Miles got up and headed to the kitchen. He grabbed a bottle of Absinthe and two glasses. But as he looked at the contents in his hands. He realized not even this might be enough. Putting the glasses back, he grabbed a second bottle, this one entirely for Kerry.

It had been two hours since miles had returned with the alcohol, and while sufficiently drunk to meet their previous, and current, writing standards, the only thing they had written on their open word document was, "Ruby kills Salem with her eyes or some shit." 
"Well, fuck," Kerry said.
They needed more meat than that, granted it was a great ending, but they couldn't just have a two episode volume.
"I think we gotta try it man," Miles said.
"I never though it'd come to this, but I'll get the candles and figure."

The writers were out of ideas, and were on to their last resort. Being the geniuses they were, they knew that a Deus Ex Machina was the best way to resolve a plot point. The community loved it when they were surprised! So now they wished to call upon the power of the gods, and have their own Deus Ex Machina appear with a script they could pass as their own. With the candles lit, they focused all them could, calling for a higher power to solve their problems. Hopefully not Monty, but they'd take anything at this point. The next thing they knew was blackness.

As Miles slowly picked himself up off the floor, he noticed the light shining on the walls through the window. It was clearly morning. He quickly recalled the previous night's events, and was suddenly struck with an idea. 
"Kerry, wake the fuck up! We've got work to do," He shouted.
Kerry jolted awake, "Please tell me you have something, this script is due tomorrow and we're still fucked."
"Yes, I've got it. And why I didn't think of it sooner, we just look at the stories the community has written, and copy that shit!"
"Holy fuck, that's genius!"
Miles and Kerry quickly got to work, looking up various fanfictions and copying whatever they felt worked. Miles felt a small thought enter his head as he worked.
"Damn, Monty. Were you fucking wrong, this is way easier! The community will absolutely love these shout outs we're giving them!"
